client.name: Adrian Tan
client.background: Adrian Tan runs a regional trading business and manages his personal investments alongside a demanding work schedule.
client.investment_objective: Reduce exposure to emerging-market debt and make part of the portfolio more readily available for personal liquidity needs.
client.loss_attitude: Adrian dislikes crystallising losses but privately accepts that reducing an existing holding may involve an unfavourable outcome.

setting.call_reason: The client calls to arrange a partial sale of his existing fund holding, with price control important to his decision.
setting.conversation_style: Brief, practical Singapore English with a courteous professional tone. The client is decisive about reducing the holding but occasionally restarts a detail or refers back to something he has already stated.

final_product.description: Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund invests in emerging-market debt and is exposed to issuer credit conditions, interest-rate movements and underlying bond-market liquidity.
concrete_risks: Deteriorating credit quality or defaults among emerging-market bond issuers can depress the fund's value.
Rising interest rates can reduce the market value of the fund's bond holdings.
Thin liquidity in underlying emerging-market bonds can worsen pricing during stressed market conditions.
final_product.recommendation_basis: Reducing the existing holding would lower the client's exposure to emerging-market credit and liquidity risks while supporting his need to free up portfolio resources. A limit instruction reflects his preference to retain control over the minimum acceptable execution price.

scenario.holding_context: The client already holds Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund in his investment portfolio and intends to sell part of that position.

red_flags.C09: The existing holding was funded with cash received from unrelated third parties. The client cannot explain the underlying commercial purpose and wants the original contributors kept out of the source-of-funds record.

edge_case_context.motivation: The client has already stated the intended sale quantity while describing his holding. When giving the final instruction, he refers back to that quantity to avoid repeating himself.
During identity verification, the client momentarily starts with the wrong component of his birth date, catches himself, and restarts before completing the detail.

additional_discussion_topics: Preference for telephone appointments over branch visits
